Marta (Auditor): Quick ask for ISO/SOC2 evidence: we need a compact deliverable that covers: 1) RBAC deltas for inference service accounts between 2025-10-01 and 2026-02-28, with a one-line risk rationale per change; 2) KMS event logs (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/EnableKeyRotation) for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abc-rotation-v2 during the CVE investigation window (2026-02-16 to 2026-02-19); 3) confirmation of emergency rotation completion and the signed audit trail. Human-friendly mapping + raw exports preferred. Can you confirm scope?
Ravi - SecEng: Confirm scope. We'll produce both: an aggregated CSV (PR, change, one-line risk rationale, deploy-id, event_ts) and raw CloudTrail JSON lines. We'll stamp each raw export with sha256 and include a README describing redaction rules.
Nina Ops: Plan: 1) filter CloudTrail for principalArns matching svc-infer-* and for KMS keyId abc-rotation-v2. 2) correlate UpdateRole/PutRolePolicy events to GitHub PRs using commit messages and deploy tag. 3) pull KMS events for the specified window and also the EnableKeyRotation / ScheduleKeyDeletion events around 2026-02-18. ETA 30m for preliminary package.
Marta (Auditor): We will sample from the raw logs. Please include indices (line numbers) so we can request specific samples. Also need a short explanation of the emergency rotation trigger (one paragraph).
Ravi - SecEng: Will add index column in CSV and produce per-PR one-liner risk notes like: "Removed wildcard iam:PassRole to reduce lateral role assumption risk; replaced with scoped PassRole limited to ecs:task/handler". Also we'll export a mapping that links eventId -> PR -> deploy-id.

Marta (Auditor): Good. A couple of specifics: a) can you capture who initiated the emergency rotation and paste the relevant runbook excerpt into the README? b) we need proof the old key material cannot be used after rotation (key state and Decrypt call behavior) — a short test log is fine.
Ravi - SecEng: Rotation initiated by user rotation-operator@redwood on 2026-02-18T04:05Z per runbook step. We'll include the runbook excerpt and a signed statement: "Post-rotation calls to Decrypt with prior key-id returned AccessDenied or NotFound after 04:05Z" plus sample calls. Example KMS lines:
```
2026-02-18T04:04:59Z Decrypt keyId=abc-rotation-v2 principal=svc-forensics requestId=req-111
2026-02-18T04:05:13Z EnableKeyRotation keyId=abc-rotation-v2 principal=rotation-operator requestId=req-112
2026-02-18T04:06:02Z Decrypt keyId=abc-rotation-v2 principal=svc-forensics requestId=req-113 result=AccessDenied
```

Marta (Auditor): Excellent. Last asks before review session: 1) add a one-sentence justification for retention/retention-period used for the exported logs; 2) confirm that any PII was redacted and list redaction methodology. We'll schedule a 30-min review after you update README.
